# Wave032 FIRST — sketches can save intersections, not membership truth

15 October2026. Blind independent FIRST; no peer032 read. **Zero new IDs/novelty claim:** refine HYP001/TLAB012 ItemCF, HYP002/046 and round074 signed-hashing cautions. This prospective approximate primitive is outside current admitted grammar.

**Mechanism.** Let a_i(v) be binary distinct view membership in `[max(S,t−168h),t)`, d_i=Σa_i, with all users/global peers and NULL-user exclusion. Store common signed sketches S_i[b]=Σ_{v:h(v)=b}s(v)a_i(v). For query user u subtract a_i(u)s(u)e_h(u) before normalization; exact remaining degree is d_i−a_i(u). Compare candidate i with frozen-history items j≠i. A query-reference sum of normalized, self-removed S_j allows one dot per candidate to approximate **unshrunk mean cosine**. Divide by the same complete history length in exact/sketch arms; unavailable terms retain their declared zero contribution plus coverage/missing reasons. This does not reproduce current thresholded/shrunk ItemCF or max.

**Semantics/cost boundary.** Binary membership updates only on0→1/1→0 transitions; duplicates and expiration of an older copy do not change it. Exact refcounts/occurrences or reviewed latest-occurrence state are still necessary. Snapshot before every global timestamp-t bucket; lower equality stays included, expiry advances even without arrivals. Raw-count vectors would instead change with bursts and require sum-of-squares norms: another type/control. Use exact binary degrees, not sketch norms; self-removal does not remove other-user collisions. A signed normalized estimate can be negative or exceed1 and must not masquerade as exact cosine/support.

**Primary fact/adaptation.** [Weinberger et al., Feature Hashing v5, Lemma2/§3](https://arxiv.org/html/0902.2206v5) establishes unbiased hashed inner products under its random-map assumptions and conditional distortion bounds; concentrated coordinates and collisions matter. The rolling/self-removed ItemCF construction is our adaptation, not its recommendation result. Fixed seeds do not turn expectation into an exact guarantee.

**Prediction/nearest UNRUN falsifier.** Repeated requested intersections may become cheaper; membership build, dense sketches and history summation may dominate. Predeclare ≤24 invented events, four users/items, three anchors and two tiny signed maps. Independent exact vectors/postings check every transition and self-removed projection; compare exact/estimated means. Include duplicate renewal/last expiry, no-arrival expiry, NULL, same-time/future peers, only-self audience, and disjoint users deliberately colliding with equal/opposite signs. Those collisions must expose false overlap/negative estimates. Any state/NULL mismatch rejects implementation; exceeding a predeclared approximation-error budget rejects that sketch setting. Proposed15CPU/30wall seconds/128MiB, zero native/fits/Y; unexecuted/ungranted.

**Task1 benefit/complete control.** A typed approximate execution alternative, not new information. Compare against independent bounded exact intersections **and** optimized cached postings/sparse-reference calculation at identical Q/C/fullY, history, norms, complete B41+feature/support/mask sink; eligible B/W remain quality references. Charge global reads/ordering, membership/expiry, I×r×b sketch storage, O(rE) updates, query-history O(r b|H|), candidate O(r b), indexes, all seeds/failures/projection/cleanup and any later native/fit work. No guaranteed memory/CPU saving, quality claim, current-final retune or018 prerequisite.

# Wave032 B FIRST — shared MinHash, explicit approximation

**Disposition:** zero new HYPs; computational refinement of HYP001/TLAB012. Jaccard is already proposed. Approximation cannot inherit HYP046's exact-equality claim; this is fixed-C scoring, without ANN/retrieval changes.

**Mechanism.** For each item, sketch its distinct view-user set in a declared seven-day snapshot. Shared hash/permutation identities permit collision-fraction Jaccard estimates; aggregate mean/max over at most20 history items, excluding the diagonal. Datasketch v1.6.5 implements coordinate-min updates/unions and collision comparison.[1] Our proposed two-minima-per-coordinate extension retains distinct user IDs to exclude query-user u from both sets; it is not stock behavior or general deletion support. Weighted MinHash estimates weighted Jaccard, not cosine; raw event multiplicity would change the weighted target.[2] Keep the binary variant first.

**Prediction.** Let A={1,…,10}, B={5,6}, C={1,2,3,4,11,…,16}. Exact Jaccard ranks C above B: .25 versus .2; cosine reverses this: .4 versus √.2. Two permutations starting (5,6,…) and (6,5,…) produce estimated Jaccard1 for B and0 for C. Their exact intersections are2 and4: collisions cannot certify support≥3. Identical singleton audiences have Jaccard1 yet become empty after removing their sole query-user. High overlap does not supply independent support.

**Nearest finite UNRUN falsifier.** Specify those sets, the singleton/empty cases, both complete16-ID permutations, and expiry of5 then6 without arrivals. Recompute exact membership and sketch minima at each state; retained two minima cannot recover A's next minimum after both expire. Scope: ≤23 initial memberships,2 permutations,46 initial rank lookups; no executed fixture or fitted model. Test masks, self-exclusion, ties and boundary peers independently. Daily rebuilding is the safe proposed contract; rolling expiry needs additional paid state/rebuilds.

**Task1 benefit/control.** Measure whether approximation reduces complete compatibility-feature cost without unacceptable distortion. Bounded exact Jaccard uses identical snapshots, history, Q/C/fullY, aggregation and NULL policy; optimized exact control builds sorted postings once and caches unique requested intersections before personal subtraction. Do not replace it with repeated uncached scans. Eligible strong B/W remain quality controls in the same future context; no new quality look now. Threshold/shrinkage support requires exact verification or an explicitly changed feature definition.

**Chronology/cost/negative outcome.** Snapshot cutoff s<t, actual bank availability≤t, whole-window coverage and age are explicit in both arms; same-time peers are excluded. For E scanned events, I items, k coordinates and R≤20Σ|Cq| requested pairs: sketch build O(kE), state O(2kI), query O(kR). Exact degrees/dedup/expiry can still require O(D) distinct-edge state. Pay all global scans, warm-up, versions, hashing, index/native work, spill, masks, sink and failures. No reservation/grant. If optimized exact is cheaper, low-support distortion dominates, or future B/W gain fails, defer.

[1] [Author code v1.6.5](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekzhu/datasketch/v1.6.5/datasketch/minhash.py).
[2] [Ioffe2010](https://research.google/pubs/improved-consistent-sampling-weighted-minhash-and-l1-sketching/).
